map.IRR 直观看收益率，但非常规现金流可能多解；NPV 直接看绝对增值，规模决策更: IRR shows the return rate directly, but unconventional cash flows may produce multiple solutions; NPV looks at absolute value added and is more reliable for scale decisions.
map.什么情况下 IRR 会算不出来？: When can IRR not be computed?
map.现金流符号多次变号（例如中途追加投资）时可能出现多个 IRR 解；若现金流全为正: When the cash flow sign changes more than once (for example additional investment midway), multiple IRR solutions may appear; if all cash flows are positive or all negative there is no solution at all. For such projects look at NPV directly rather than relying on IRR.
